steps.code:
# Let's get all liked songs by paginating.
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2FzX21vb3JlQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.Ry-dT0WNVUiSCQYSD3KUYzl-EGoNtS5NB0ssm2lBGNQ'
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_ids)}")
print(liked_ids)

steps.code:
# Now we'll go to previous songs until we find a liked one.
access_token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2FzX21vb3JlQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsImV4cCI6MTY4NDQxMjA5OH0.Ry-dT0WNVUiSCQYSD3KUYzl-EGoNtS5NB0ssm2lBGNQ'
liked_ids = {9, 147, 278, 23, 27, 33, 291, 299, 45, 193, 68, 196, 82, 216, 90, 225, 117, 122, 254}

# First check if current song is already liked (unlikely but just in case)
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song:", current['song_id'], current['title'])
if current['song_id'] in liked_ids:
    print("Already liked, no need to go previous.")
else:
    # Loop until we find a liked song
    for _ in range(1000):  # safety limit
        # Go to previous song
        prev_resp = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
        print("Moved to previous, new song id:", prev_resp.get('song_id'))
        # Get current song details
        current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
        print("Current song:", current['song_id'], current['title'])
        if current['song_id'] in liked_ids:
            print("Found liked song!")
            break
    else:
        print("No liked song found in queue")
